page.overview:
Who is Rolento?

Rolento is a muscular, athletic and acrobatic German-American man with solid white eyes (depicted as pupil-less in most official artworks), pronounced jaw and cheekbones, and a scar running down from his forehead through his nose bridge and into the left side of his face.

Rolento's uniform is green tiger stripe camouflage fatigues with a brown belt and a brown leather chest-harness with two scarlet grenades. A scarlet beret on his head, brown wristbands, dark-green military equestrian boots and his staff is also dark-green.

On his uniform, he wears a sleeveless-shirt and grenades which are both scarlet like his beret, but the official artwork depicts both Rolento's grenades and sleeveless-shirt as black, this is due to hardware limitations on color-palettes.

Rolento wears yellow military fatigues with a red scarf on his neck, a brown belt, a brown leather chest-harness with two grenades, a red beret on his head, brown military equestrian boots, and brown fingerless gloves. He fights with a green staff and green grenades, which were changed from a regular green to army-green in Street Fighter Alpha 3.
